text.description_html:
Omnia 124.EXT, Extra Thick Door Omnia Privacy Pin Extension

This is a 8 mm long extension for privacy function pins. It is for use with Omnia door lever sets, Omnia door knob sets, and Omnia stainless steel levers installed on 2 - 2-1/4 inch thick doors.

Screws into a push pin on a privacy function (Bed or Bathroom) door latch so it will work on extra thick doors form 2 - 2-1/4 inches.

Warning: These work for knobs and levers manufactured by Omnia only. If you are not sure if your hardware was manufactured by Omnia, do NOT order these as they may not work properly.

*Sold Individually - NO RETURNS
